snippet.title: Boston CSS
snippet.description:
A collection of recorded presentations for the Boston CSS meetup group.

Boston CSS is a meetup group that meets the first Wednesday of each month. We plan and host presentations and workshops for people of all levels interested in CSS! 

http://www.meetup.com/Boston-CSS/
